adv_substring_trap_02.judge_reason: The 'purge' mutation removes the row 'Account password for backup: raven42#secure.', but the must_not_contain strings 'raven42' and 'raven42#secure' are substrings of the purged row, leading to a substring-collision bug.
adv_substring_trap_02.note: Judge confuses 'substring of purged row' with 'substring of surviving row'. After purge, the password row is gone; surviving facts (raven silhouette, hackathon, HVAC) contain neither 'raven42' nor 'raven42#secure'. Well-formed.

adv_prefix_collision_07.judge_reason: The must_not_contain string 'case_id 12345 was filed' is a substring of the surviving fact 'Legal case_id 123456 was filed in appellate court.'
adv_prefix_collision_07.note: Judge's substring claim is arithmetically false. 'case_id 12345 was filed' is NOT a substring of 'case_id 123456 was filed' (after '12345' the must_not has ' was' but row 2 has '6 was'). Well-formed.

adv_prefix_collision_16.judge_reason: The must_not_contain string '+1-555-0100 is the main' is a substring of the setup fact '+1-555-0100 is the main office line.', which was not targeted by the purge mutation.
adv_prefix_collision_16.note: Judge mis-identifies which row gets purged. Purge target 'phone +1-555-0100 office line' matches row 1 (which IS purged), not row 2. After purge, row 2 ('+1-555-01000 is the fax') does not contain '+1-555-0100 is the main' (the digit after '0100' is '0' in row 2, not ' '). Well-formed.

adv_shared_attribute_04.judge_reason: The 'release' mutation marks the fact 'Hannah leads the backend team' as unreachable, but the must_not_contain string 'Hannah and Ivan share' is a substring of the surviving fact.
adv_shared_attribute_04.note: Judge interprets 'release everything about Hannah on the team' as releasing only one row. The release semantic is multi-row by design — should release fact (1) about Hannah AND Ivan sharing office AND fact (2) about Hannah leading backend. After both released, surviving = Ivan + Judy facts. Well-formed.

adv_identifier_obfuscation_02.judge_reason: The purge removes all bob@example.com facts, but final_query asks about bob@example.com, which is a contradiction.
adv_identifier_obfuscation_02.note: Judge mis-reads test intent. final_query='What did bob buy?' is the test query — correct system returns nothing because bob was purged (verifying purge succeeded). Well-formed.

adv_identifier_obfuscation_08.judge_reason: Purge of '@acme-engineer contractor' removes only the @-form row, leaving the without-@ row.

adv_identifier_obfuscation_09.judge_reason: Purge of '192.168.1.5' leaves substrings in both '192.168.001.005' and '192.168.1.5 (no padding)' rows.
adv_identifier_obfuscation_09.note: IPv4 padded/unpadded should be canonicalized as same. Well-formed.

adv_recursive_supersession_02.judge_reason: End state contains 'returned to vegetarian' which includes 'started eating meat in 2021' as part of the superseded fact.
adv_recursive_supersession_02.note: Judge confuses chained supersession. After supersede 1 ('vegetarian' -> 'meat 2021') then supersede 2 ('meat' -> 'vegetarian 2024'), only the final row remains.
